DEWALT DCS367N-XJ 18V XR brushless cordless reciprocating saw offers powerful and efficient cutting for demanding trade applications, such as demolition, pruning, and construction tasks. Features a compact 363mm design, with a weight of 2.3kg, ideal for accessing confined spaces and reduces fatigue. The robust, advanced brushless motor ensures extended runtime and enhanced power for tasks such as cutting steel up to 100mm or wood up to 300mm. A variable speed trigger enables precise speed adjustment, and a quick-release, 4-position, lever-actuated blade clamp offers versatile use, allowing for flush cutting and tool-free blade changes. An integrated LED work light improves visibility, and the electronic brake enhances safety. Also features a durable all-metal gearbox and comfortable ergonomic handle with rubber overmould grip. Compatible with all DEWALT 18V XR Li-Ion batteries and chargers (sold separately).
